Don’t Replace Your Roof. Renew It. # Give Your Aging Shingles a Second Life. # Shingle Renew Pro helps property owners preserve aging asphalt shingle roofs with professional roof rejuvenation — without the cost and disruption of a full roof replacement.
Get Your Free Roof Assessment
Learn How It Works
Your Roof May Not Need to Be Replaced Yet # An aging asphalt shingle roof doesn’t automatically mean it’s time for a tear-off.
Our roof rejuvenation treatment is designed to replenish the oils and flexibility that shingles can lose as they age, helping preserve the roof you already have.
Preserve Your Investment # Extend the useful life of an existing asphalt shingle roof instead of replacing it prematurely.
Restore Shingle Flexibility # Replenish lost oils and help aging shingles remain more flexible and resilient.
Reduce Premature Replacement # A roof that’s still structurally sound may have years of useful life remaining.
How It Works # 01 — Inspect # We evaluate the age, condition, and overall health of your asphalt shingle roof to determine whether rejuvenation is appropriate.
02 — Prepare # We prepare the roof and surrounding areas for professional application.
03 — Rejuvenate # Our rejuvenation treatment is applied evenly across the shingles to restore lost oils and help protect against further aging.
Is Your Roof Showing Signs of Aging? # You may be a candidate for roof rejuvenation if you’re seeing:
Granules accumulating in your gutters Shingles becoming dry or brittle Fading or weathered appearance Minor cracking or loss of flexibility An asphalt shingle roof that’s approaching or beyond 10 years old Replacement Isn’t Your Only Option # A complete roof replacement can be expensive, disruptive, and unnecessary when an existing roof is still structurally sound.
Before you commit to a replacement, find out whether your roof can be renewed.
Save Your Roof. Save Your Money. # We’ll inspect your roof and help you understand whether rejuvenation makes sense for your property.
Get Your Free Roof Assessment
Ready to Find Out If Your Roof Can Be Renewed? # Don’t replace your roof before exploring your options.
Shingle Renew Pro
Professional Roof Rejuvenation
Request a Free Assessment
Contact # Tell us about your roof and we’ll help you determine whether roof rejuvenation may be right for you.
